# Model




```{r}
ordinal_classifier <- nn_module(
  "ordinal_classifier",
  initialize = function(){
    #browser()
    # self$gene_names
    self$layers <- nn_sequential(
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 33694L, out_features = 3072L), nn_tanh(), 
      nn_linear(in_features = 3072L, out_features = 2048L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 2048L, out_features = 1024L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 1024L, out_features = 1L)
    ) 
  },
  
  forward = function(x){
    x |> self$layers()
  }
)
```

## Data prep

```{r}
sce_sampled <- sce_merged[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_merged)[2]), size = 10e3)]

train <- sce_sampled[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_sampled)[2]), size = dim(sce_sampled)[2]*.7)]
test <- sce_sampled[, !colnames(sce_sampled) %in% colnames(train)]

```



```{r prados_delayed_ds}

delayed_ds <- dataset(
  name = "sce_dataset",
 
  initialize = function(x,y) {
    self$x <- x;self$y <- y
    stopifnot(identical(length(y),nrow(x)))
  },
 
  .length = function() {length(self$y)},
 
  .getbatch = function(index) { list(
    x = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$x[index, ,drop=FALSE]), torch_float()),
    y = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$y[index], ncol=1), torch_long())
  )},
 
  .getitem = function(index) {
    if (is.list(index)) {index <- unlist(index)}
    self$.getbatch(index)
  }
)
```



```{r}
train_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.integer(train$BraakStage))
```


```{r}
test_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(test)), as.integer(test$BraakStage))
```



## Loss function


```{r}
pred <- torch_tensor(as.numeric(train$BraakStage[1:10]))
target <- torch_tensor(as.numeric(train$BraakStage[5:14]))
```


```{r}
ij <- torch_combinations(torch_arange(1,length(pred), dtype = torch_long()))
```




```{r}
l <- nnf_margin_ranking_loss(input1 = pred[ij[,1]], input2= pred[ij[,2]], target = sign(target[ij[,1]] - target[ij[,2]]),reduction = "none",margin = 1)

m <- cbind(as_array(ij), as_array(pred[ij[,1]]), as_array(pred[ij[,2]]),as_array(target[ij[,1]]) ,as_array(target[ij[,2]]) ,as_array(l))
```



```{r}
m <- torch_tensor(m[-which(m[,5]==m[,6]),], dtype = torch_long())
```


```{r}
scaling_factor <- function(ranks){
  m_2 <- length(ranks)**2 
  m_sum <- sum(table(ranks)**2)
  (m_2-m_sum)*0.5
}

sf <- scaling_factor(train_ds$y)
```



```{r}
c <- torch_tensor(matrix(c(0,2,6, 2,0,4, 6,4,0), nrow = 3, ncol = 3,
       dimnames = list(c("1", "2", "3"),
                       c("1", "2", "3"))), dtype = torch_long(), device = "cuda")
c <- c/sf
```



```{r}
p <- torch_diag(c[m[,c(4,6)][,1], m[,c(4,6)][,2]])
```



```{r}
nnf_ordinal_regression_loss <- function(pred,target,c=NULL){
  # combinations
  ij <- torch_combinations(torch_arange(1,length(pred)+1, dtype = torch_long()))
  # margin ranking loss
  l <- nnf_margin_ranking_loss(input1 = pred[ij[,1]]$squeeze(-1L),
                               input2= pred[ij[,2]]$squeeze(-1L),
                               target = sign(target[ij[,1]] - target[ij[,2]])$squeeze(-1L),
                               reduction = "none",margin = 1)
  
  if (!is.null(c)){
    # removing equal predictions
    # yi <- target[ij[,1]]; yj <- target[ij[,2]]
    # msk <- yi!=yj
    # yi <- yi[msk]; yj <- yj[msk]
    
    # gathering cost values for predicted values
    #browser()
    #browser()
    p <- torch_diag(c[target[ij[,1]]$squeeze(-1L), target[ij[,2]]$squeeze(-1L)])
    # weighted loss
    loss <- l$dot(p$squeeze(-1L))
  } else {loss <- l$sum()}
  
}
```



```{r}
nn_ordinal_regression_loss <- nn_module(
  "nn_ordinal_regression_loss",
  initialize = function(c=NULL){
    self$c <- c
  },
  forward = function(input, target){
    nnf_ordinal_regression_loss(input, target, c = self$c)
  }
  
)
```
